title: Primitives
description: Shared value definitions for every STARFALL contract. Reference them with $ref; do not copy patterns into type schemas. Rules: docs/adr/0002-contract-format-and-codegen.md

Uuid.description: Canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID of any version. Use only where the producer cannot guarantee v7.

UuidV7.description: Canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID version 7 (RFC 9562). Default identifier format for entities, events, commands and messages. Consumers must not derive game facts from the embedded timestamp.

SchemaVersion.description: Payload schema version of a registry type. Starts at 1. 매핑은 declared minimum/maximum으로 결정한다.

SafeInteger.description: Signed integer limited to the IEEE-754 safe range (+/- 2^53-1) so every JSON consumer represents it exactly. Integer language mapping is decided by the declared minimum/maximum, never by a format annotation.

NonNegativeSafeInteger.description: Unsigned integer limited to 0..2^53-1. Mapped to the narrowest language type that holds the declared range.

Tick.description: Simulation tick number. The canonical game-time axis: ordering and determinism use tick (+ sequence), never wall-clock time.

Sequence.description: Deterministic order of events within one tick, starting at 0.

MoneyMinor.description: Amount of money in integer minor units. Floating-point money is forbidden. The currency and its minor-unit scale are defined by the field or data table that uses it.

GameTime.description: Game-calendar timestamp derived deterministically from tick (e.g. 3827-04-13T18:32:11Z). Display and history text only: it is NOT real time and must never be parsed as a real DateTime or used for ordering.

RealTime.description: Real wall-clock UTC timestamp, RFC 3339 profile with mandatory Z and optional 1-9 fractional digits. Audit and diagnostics only; never used for game rules.

DataId.description: Identifier of a row in a game data table (ship class, star system), in lower-kebab-case - EXACTLY the string that row's `id` field carries in data/. There is no case or separator transform between the data table and the wire: a transform is a place where two spellings of the same id can drift apart. The server indexes data/ by the `id` FIELD, never by the file name, so renaming a file does not rewrite history. Stable for the life of the row: it is written into domain events, so renaming one rewrites history (principle 5).

PositionMm.description: One axis of a star-system-local position, in integer millimetres (ADR-0009). 좌표계 규약 (ADR-0009 section 1): 왼손 좌표계, Y-up. +X = 함선 기준 오른쪽, +Y = 위, +Z = 전방(뱃머리). 쿼터니언은 (x,y,z,w) 순서의 Hamilton 곱. 이 문장이 축 의미의 정본이며 구현은 여기서만 읽는다. The wire carries no floating point: the server holds f64 metres and quantises once, so every consumer sees the same bytes. Range is structural headroom (+/-1e12 mm), NOT the play area - that limit is a game rule in the star system data table.

VelocityMmPerSecond.description: One axis of a velocity, in integer millimetres per second (ADR-0009). 좌표계 규약 (ADR-0009 section 1): 왼손 좌표계, Y-up. +X = 함선 기준 오른쪽, +Y = 위, +Z = 전방(뱃머리). 쿼터니언은 (x,y,z,w) 순서의 Hamilton 곱. 이 문장이 축 의미의 정본이며 구현은 여기서만 읽는다. Range is structural headroom (+/-100 km/s); the ship class table sets the real maximum speed.

QuaternionComponentMicro.description: One component of a normalised quaternion, in millionths (1e-6). 좌표계 규약 (ADR-0009 section 1): 왼손 좌표계, Y-up. +X = 함선 기준 오른쪽, +Y = 위, +Z = 전방(뱃머리). 쿼터니언은 (x,y,z,w) 순서의 Hamilton 곱. 이 문장이 축 의미의 정본이며 구현은 여기서만 읽는다. The quantised quaternion is not exactly unit length; both producer and consumer renormalise before use, and a quaternion whose norm is below 1e-3 is degenerate and is replaced by the ship's current attitude rather than rejected (ADR-0010 section 2).

AngularVelocityMdegPerSecond.description: One axis of a WORLD-frame angular velocity, in integer millidegrees per second (ADR-0009, ADR-0010 section 2). World frame, not ship frame: the attitude integrator is defined with a world-frame omega, and carrying it on the wire is what lets a client rebase its rotation state and not just its orientation.

ControlAxisMilli.description: One axis of a control intent, in thousandths of full deflection: -1000..1000 maps to -1.0..1.0. 좌표계 규약 (ADR-0009 section 1): 왼손 좌표계, Y-up. +X = 함선 기준 오른쪽, +Y = 위, +Z = 전방(뱃머리). 쿼터니언은 (x,y,z,w) 순서의 Hamilton 곱. 이 문장이 축 의미의 정본이며 구현은 여기서만 읽는다. It is an INTENT, never a resulting speed or position - the server multiplies it by the ship class limits. Out-of-range values are rejected, not clamped: carry-forward (ADR-0011 section 4) means a rejected input costs no control continuity, so silence is not needed to avoid a hitch (I-33).

InputSeq.description: Per-session control input counter chosen by the client, starting at 1 and increasing by 1 per input. One input carries the WHOLE control intent for one tick; it is absolute state, not a delta, so a superseded input is harmless (ADR-0011 section 4). A reconnect starts a new session and the counter restarts at 1. It is not an ordering authority - the tick loop orders by gateway submission sequence (I-11).
